goal_statement: Add a server-side search endpoint to the Multica API that queries tasks by keyword.

in_scope: New GET /api/tasks/search?q= endpoint in Go backend
Search logic scoped to the tasks table only
Unit tests for the search handler

success_criteria: GET /api/tasks/search?q=keyword returns matching tasks for the authenticated workspace
Handler returns 400 for missing q parameter
known_constraints: Must use existing sqlc query patterns
Must use existing Chi router middleware for auth
